Notes

三毛

The character is introduced as a friend called 三毛, pronounced Sānmáo. The artist’s official track list credits this song’s production to 3MAO, giving the name a concrete connection within the record’s credits. The song does not establish the karate story as the producer’s biography.

  • Jack Zebra: official Zhuang Zhuang track list
空手道

空手道 is karate-dō, literally the “way of the empty hand.” The name gives a compact explanation for the previous boast that Sanmao does not need to carry a knife. The next emphasis on technique rather than strength also keeps the portrait focused on acquired skill.

  • Genius community transcript
  • Japan Karate Association: meaning of karate-dō
开始录像

“Start recording” turns the listener from a recipient of the tale into a potential spectator with a camera. Later the narrative shifts from “he” to “we” applauding: the scene is as concerned with witnessing the fighter as with the fight itself.

  • Genius community transcript
真正的功夫之神

The portrait first stresses humility, a low profile and limited physical strength. It then calls him the true “god of kung fu” and surrounds him with war, faith and collective applause. That escalating language supplies the larger-than-life tone even though the scene ends on an ordinary platform.

  • Genius community transcript
